Module com.example.miniproyecto3_battleship
Package com.example.miniproyecto3_battleship.model.Player

Class APlayer

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto3_battleship.model.Player.APlayer
All Implemented Interfaces:
IPlayer, Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
PlayerBot, PlayerPerson
public abstract class APlayer extends Object implements IPlayer
Abstract class representing a generic player in the Battleship game.

The APlayer class provides a base implementation for both human and bot players, including common functionalities such as managing the ship matrix and verifying the winner.

Subclasses must implement specific behaviors for their player types.

The ship matrix is represented as a 2D ArrayList of integers, where each cell indicates the state (e.g., empty, occupied, or hit).

Juan David Lopez v

    • generateBotGame

      public void generateBotGame()
      Description copied from interface: IPlayer
      Generates the bot's ship placements randomly on the game board.

      This method initializes a predefined number of ships of different sizes, assigns them random positions and orientations, and ensures that no ships overlap.

      It updates the bot's ship matrix with the placed ships and handles potential exceptions caused by invalid placements.

      Specified by:

      public boolean verifyWinner()
      Description copied from interface: IPlayer
